intro.title: Different intelligences. One single purpose.
intro.p1:
We believe great results do not depend on technology alone.
They depend on strategy, collaboration, precision, protection, adaptation and the ability to execute.
intro.p2: That is why we created the BTF Intelligence Ecosystem: a set of intelligences representing the capabilities required to turn complex challenges into consistent results.
intro.p3: Each intelligence represents a strength. Together, they represent BTF.

liga.altSuffix: intelligence of the BTF Intelligence Ecosystem

Nexant represents the ability to build solutions in a structured way, connecting people, processes and technology.
No transformation happens in isolation. Great results are built with collaboration, organization and collective intelligence.

BEEYA.desc:
Beeya represents the connection between ideas, people and technologies.
It is the intelligence that seeks new possibilities, identifies opportunities and turns different elements into innovative solutions.

AURON.desc:
Auron represents the ability to see beyond the immediate problem.
Before acting, you must understand the landscape, anticipate risks and identify opportunities.
It is the intelligence responsible for strategic vision.

KINGLY.desc:
Kingly represents security, trust and protection.
In a world driven by data and technology, growing also means protecting the information, processes and assets that matter to the business.

VECTOR.desc:
Strategy without execution creates no transformation.
Vector represents movement, direction and the ability to turn planning into results.
It is the intelligence of delivery.

LUMI.desc:
Technology is made for people.
Lumi represents the intelligence that places human experience at the center of decisions, making sure innovation and transformation make sense for whoever uses the solution.

RAMMIUS.desc:
Transforming requires the courage to change.
Rammius represents the strength needed to overcome barriers, break patterns and guide companies through transformation processes.

PRISMA.desc:
Small details can create major impact.
Prisma represents precision, quality and attention to the elements that ensure the reliability of a solution.

FLOW.desc:
Markets change. Technology changes. So do businesses.
Flow represents the ability to continuously adapt and evolve in the face of new challenges, scenarios and opportunities.

items.q: My company grew very fast, but I got lost in the process. Where can BTF help me?
items.a: BTF helps reorganize your company's growth through a diagnosis of processes, technology, projects and information. We identify bottlenecks, prioritize opportunities and structure solutions to bring more control, efficiency and predictability to operations.

items.q: I have some internal systems, but they don't integrate. What needs to be done?
items.a: First, we assess the systems, processes and data involved. Based on that diagnosis, we define the best integration, automation or technology evolution strategy, aiming to reduce rework and centralize information that matters to the business.

items.q: I have technology, but I can't extract all the potential.
items.a: Technology without strategy, well-defined processes and follow-up may not deliver the expected result. BTF assesses the current scenario, identifies improvement opportunities and creates a plan so your technology investments generate more productivity, control and business value.

items.q: Is my data safe during the consulting project?
items.a: Protecting information is a fundamental part of how we work. We operate with confidentiality, access control, security best practices and data protection principles suited to the nature and scope of each project.

items.q: How long does it take to implement a CRM or automation solution?
items.a: The timeline depends on business complexity, the number of processes, integrations and project goals. Leaner solutions can be implemented in a few weeks, while more robust projects require planning and phased execution. After the diagnosis, we present a clear and realistic schedule.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy | BTF. Blue Trust Force
privacy.metaDescription: How BTF. Blue Trust Force collects, uses, stores and protects personal data in compliance with the Brazilian data protection law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
BTF. Blue Trust Force (company ID 46.165.879/0001-22) respects your privacy. This policy describes how we handle personal data collected on this website, in compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).

1. Data we collect

  • Contact data voluntarily provided in forms: name, email, phone, company and job title.
  • The content of the message sent through the assessment form.
  • The email address provided for the newsletter, subject to explicit opt-in.
  • Anonymized browsing data, only when you consent to analytics cookies.

2. Purposes and legal basis

We use the data to respond to business enquiries, run technical assessments and send requested communications. The legal basis is the data subject's consent and, where applicable, pre-contractual procedures.

3. Sharing

We do not sell personal data. We share information only with processors required to deliver the service (cloud infrastructure and lead management tools), always under confidentiality obligations.

4. Retention

We keep data for as long as needed for the purposes above or until you request deletion, except where retention is legally mandatory.

5. Data subject rights

You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, withdrawal of consent and deletion of your data. Just write to contato@bluetrustforce.com.br.

6. Security

We apply technical and organizational controls aligned with information security best practices, including encryption in transit, access control and monitoring.

7. Recruitment and selection (Careers)

Purpose: to assess applications for current and future roles at BTF, run selection processes and stay in touch with candidates.

Data collected: full name, professional email, phone, role of interest, short introduction, optional LinkedIn or portfolio link and a PDF résumé, plus technical file metadata (name, size, type and submission date).

Legal basis: the data subject's consent (art. 7, I, LGPD) and pre-contractual procedures related to a potential employment contract (art. 7, V).

Retention period: 12 months from the application date. After that period, the record and the résumé are securely deleted by an automated routine.

Sharing: data is accessed only by BTF's authorized HR team and contracted cloud infrastructure processors, under confidentiality obligations. Résumés are never published, sold or sent to third parties without a legal basis.

Security measures: HTTPS transmission, storage in a private repository with encryption at rest, no public URLs, internal access with authentication and role-based authorization, temporary signed links expiring in 10 minutes, and audit logs of views, downloads and deletions.

Rights and deletion: you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, portability, withdrawal of consent and deletion of your application and résumé at any time. The data protection officer can be reached at contato@bluetrustforce.com.br. Deletion requests remove both the record and the file, with an audit entry.

8. Cookies

Cookie usage is detailed in our Cookie Policy. No analytics or marketing cookie is activated before your consent.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.body:
Cookies are small files stored on your device while you browse. On this website, no analytics or marketing cookie is loaded before your explicit consent.

Categories used

  • Necessary: essential for the website to work, such as storing your cookie preference and selected language. They cannot be disabled.
  • Analytics: measure page performance and usage (Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics). Only activated after acceptance.
  • Marketing: enable campaign measurement and remarketing. Only activated after acceptance.

Consent record

Your choice is stored locally with date, time and the version of this policy (current version: {{version}}). When we publish a new version, we ask for your choice again.

How to change your decision

You can review or withdraw your consent at any time using the button below, or the “Manage cookies” link in the footer. You can also delete cookies through your browser settings.
